history.note: 4-1. Concurrences require the 48-hour clocks in s 8.5(3) and (5) to be harmonised and a resubmission rule; dissent requires a deemed-granted code not to confer s 8.6(2) immunity or bar s 8.8(2) takedown. Carry to a later turn.

Unanimous rejection, including the proposer. Harm accepted; pre-clearance of numerical framing rejected as content adjudication. Preferred alternative: objective basis-disclosure duty enforced by post-publication correction, or a narrow Q5 offence.

5-0 unanimous minor approval. Implements the turn 1 conditions: one applicable 48-hour period, a 24-hour correction/resubmission rule, a single incompleteness notice confined to s 8.5(2), and a deemed-code register/review/takedown safeguard. Conditions carried: lapse rule for non-correction; clarify deemed code is pre-clearance for s 8.6; s 8.6(2) platform immunity still applies; update s 8.12.
